query:
SELECT EXISTS (
                 SELECT 1
                   FROM org_domain d
                   JOIN connection c
                     ON c.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND c.org_id = d.org_id
                    AND c.id = d.connection_id
                  WHERE d.tenant_id = $1 AND d.verified_at IS NOT NULL AND d.routing
                    AND c.enabled) AS "exists!"
